parakeet: So to be clear, it took early Christians approximately 150 years from the alleged crucifixion, 120 years from the alleged composition of the earliest gospel, and 110 years from Paul's earliest writings for the church to get organized enough to decide who wrote the gospels that they later claimed were handed down by the apostles themselves. Do with that what thou wilt.
